result.excerpt: Contains the GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) for all TTC transportation modes
result.name: merged-gtfs-ttc-routes-and-schedules
result.notes:
Data contains scheduling information (route definitions, stop patterns, stop locations, and schedules)  for all TTC transportation modes (subway, streetcars, and buses). The data is published as a GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) file format.

The following URL provides a detailed description of the GTFS file format: http://code.google.com/transit/spec/transitfeedspecification.html

The following URLs provide detailed descriptions of the accessibility information being added to the GTFS specification:

* [https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs](https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs )

* [https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs-realtime](https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs-realtime)

Data contains scheduling information (route definitions, stop patterns, stop locations, and schedules). The TTC provides updates approx. every 6 weeks.
result.title: Merged GTFS - TTC Routes and Schedules
